feature_questions: Grain boundaries; pores; cleavage; fracture; weathering; tool marks
required_evidence: Identify scene-used rock type; traceable specimen or authoritative material-specific source; scale, measurement method and uncertainty
provisional_digital_representation: Macro silhouette/large fractures as geometry; displacement only when scale and mesh support it; normal/roughness for unresolved detail
notes: Family placeholder only; do not infer sandstone/limestone/granite/etc. without asset assignment and evidence.

feature_questions: Particle-size distribution and sorting; clumping; compaction; cracks; moisture-dependent structure
required_evidence: Identify scene-used soil/sediment; particle-size evidence or traceable specimen study; state and moisture conditions
provisional_digital_representation: Silhouette-scale clumps and cracks as geometry; finer grains as texture only where resolvable and evidence-supported
notes: Dry/wet appearance and cohesion must be treated as separate states, not a single universal preset.

feature_questions: Grain direction; vessels; rays; knots; growth features; split/cut surfaces; bark structure
required_evidence: Species or explicit family-level uncertainty; orientation; cut type; surface preparation/wear evidence; traceable anatomy source
provisional_digital_representation: Directional mapping for grain; geometry/displacement only for features large enough at target shot scale
notes: Do not assign a named species from appearance alone; keep species uncertainty explicit.

feature_questions: Polish; scratches; hammer/casting marks; corrosion; patina; coatings; directional finishing
required_evidence: Specific metal/alloy identity; fabrication and finish evidence; sourced or measured optical reference; aging/environment state
provisional_digital_representation: Reflectance model plus mapped/geometric defects at justified scales; corrosion/coating as distinct layers when supported
notes: No alloy, roughness, or reflectance values assigned yet. Do not treat all metals as one preset.

feature_questions: Pores; inclusions; firing/processing marks; chips; glaze, slip, plaster or coating layers
required_evidence: Body/binder/finish identity; production process evidence; relevant specimen or traceable source; layer structure where applicable
provisional_digital_representation: Separate body and surface finish; geometry for large chips/cracks; shading detail only for unresolved scales
notes: Ceramic body, glaze, slip, mortar and plaster are not interchangeable identities.

feature_questions: Yarn twist; weave topology; fibre fuzz; folds; fraying; seams; finish
required_evidence: Fibre and weave identity; yarn/feature scale; reference imagery or physical measurement; garment/prop context
provisional_digital_representation: Explicit weave geometry only when resolved; otherwise validated shading/normal detail; folds/frays modeled at shot-relevant scales
notes: Fibre identity and weave construction are separate fields. Do not assume all ancient textiles are one weave.

feature_questions: Pores; fibres; growth structure; cut edges; polish; surface damage; shell/nacre layering
required_evidence: Split into actual scene-used identities (leather/hide, bone, horn, shell/nacre); processing state; source or specimen
provisional_digital_representation: Material-specific shading and geometry; separate shell/nacre layers where justified; no generic organic preset by assumption
notes: This is a triage family, not one material identity; split into separate material records before final approval.

feature_questions: Particle size; packing; adhesion; substrate interaction; coverage variation; dry/wet state
required_evidence: Residue identity and substrate; particle/substrate evidence; application and environmental state; source or specimen
provisional_digital_representation: Particle geometry or layered coverage according to shot scale; distinguish loose deposits from adhered coatings
notes: Ash, soot, pigments and residues are not equivalent; split when actual asset use is known.
